show.description: After vanishing for five years, the eldest daughter of a powerful family suddenly returns, sending shockwaves through the household. Declared the official heir, her comeback disrupts long-standing power dynamics, stirring envy, panic, and false smiles. A dramatic tale of inheritance, ambition, and the chaos that follows when the forgotten become unforgettable.
